summary: An advanced variant selection component for products with many options, using an off-canvas sheet to display variants grouped by color with thumbnails and pricing.
features: Off-canvas sheet with grouped variant display
Variant thumbnails with price, stock info, and savings badges
Radio group selection with real-time product updates
Amount pills showing available colors and sizes
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Multiple Variant Selection component handles products with many variant combinations, providing a scalable interface for stores like Ambiendo that offer extensive color and size options. It prevents buy box clutter by moving variant selection into an organized off-canvas panel.

## Use Cases

- Handling products with many variant combinations via off-canvas selection panel
- Selecting product variants such as size and color using grouped displays
- Viewing variant-specific pricing, stock status, and savings information
- Browsing variants organized by color groups with swatches

## Design Rationale

The off-canvas approach solves the challenge of displaying many variants without overwhelming the main product page. Grouping variants by color with visual swatches helps customers quickly navigate to their desired option. Each variant card shows complete purchasing information including price, stock status, and savings to enable informed decisions without returning to the main page. The radio group pattern ensures single selection while providing immediate visual feedback.
